small_occultor_cpu_probe.limit: Numerical failure aborts outside prior handlers; existing originalCPU route unchanged

geometry_and_fields.mapping: Each original angular parent face maps barycentric vectorv to rayv/|v|. Duffy Gauss weights use |det(a,b,c)|/|v|³. Original CPU potential with56bisections on1e-6..0.25 gives actual Roche points; original analytic gradient gives normal and radial Jacobianr²|gradPhi|/(gradPhi dot radial). No scalar correction on integration geometry.
geometry_and_fields.fields: Original corrected finite gravity-darkened/reflected thermal/radiance/LD fields remain piecewise constant per angular parent face. They are rebuilt for each candidate and retain original correction, cached geometry/build order, cooler-first irradiation/prefix and atmosphere/LD semantics. Field convergence and bolometric energy normalization with the curved measure are not certified.
geometry_and_fields.eclipses: Visibility and shadows use the same implicit Roche surfaces. Positive companion/rotation terms supply inscribedradiusm/Omega; central rays blocked. Remaining projected candidates solve originalgradient dotLOS=0 with positive local derivative, bounded displacement and64eps*|gradient| residual guard, then originalpotential predicate. IndependentBrent line tangencies and analytic sphere intersections control these cases.
geometry_and_fields.boundary: Seven-probe/two-diameter adaptation is empirical, not interval-bounded or exact boundary integration. Actual Duffy node masks use true normal and implicit shadow. No silent coarsening on cap failure. Finite depth/order controls remain mandatory.
geometry_and_fields.field_boundary_coupling: A different field grid also changes patch basis and absolute boundary leaf size; fixed integerdepth is a coupled refinement. Window042 compares field1-depth4 with field2-depth3 at matched dyadic scale. Their angular bases still differ; this is not an exact isolation of continuous-field error.
geometry_and_fields.hybrid: True roots, normals/Jacobians, adaptive partition and eclipse masks are common freshCPU bridges. Device corrected finite fields/reflection/BBemission and originalLD/weighted integration are connected. CK04 explicitlyCPU radiance. Not allGPU and no physical prediction cache across candidates.
geometry_and_fields.domain: Circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q[.5,2],spin[.5,1.5],inner radial1e-6..0.25 with explicit geometry/residual guards; fieldlevels0-2,max20276parents/star,orders2-4,depth0-7,max2097152quadrature nodes/star/phase,1-8bands,1-128phases. Resource/unsupported numerics abort standalone protocol, not prior cuts. DefaultCPU/general fallback routes unchanged.

validation_and_science.oracle: New numerical integration differs intentionally from original faceted curves. CPU parity oracle composes original CPU finite fields/reflection/radiance and per-element flux primitives with the same new quadrature. Whole unchangedCPUcurve differences are separately labelled method changes, never called implementation parity.
validation_and_science.independence: Independent originalradiusNewton versus vectorbisection roots, angular finite-difference Jacobians, Brent line tangencies, closed-form sphere area/LD and uniform occulting-disk overlap controls. Sphere partial/total/grazing normalized overlap error<=5e-6 at testeddepth7, separate from unchanged3e-13/2e-12 implementation gates. OriginalCPUbefore/after equality and fresh physics/response/source identity controls pass.
validation_and_science.accuracy: Area agreement alone does not qualify eclipse/light-curve accuracy. Depth2/3/4 and order3/4, coupled field refinement and matched-scale controls remain finite empirical changes. No continuum error bound, continuous-field certificate, exposure integration, physical-systematics claim or qualified posterior.
validation_and_science.inference: Original physical serializers, constraints, priors, phase/JD reducers/repeats, thirdlight/mean/noise/density with a new numerical synthesis hook. Accuracy failures remain outside candidate penalties; nominal errors independent of ln_f. Data-dependent finite likelihood bound includes residual cross term. No curved public sampler backend, optimized fit, chain convergence orESS assessment.
validation_and_science.known_numeric_rejection: CPUreference small-occultorPhi[8,100] probe is rejected by unchanged FP64 stationary-residual guard. OriginalCPU route control completes. This is an explicit unsupported numerical case, not a prior cut or accepted inaccurate curve. Local-coordinate conditioning needs investigation; no GPU/accuracy claim for this probe.
validation_and_science.next: Boundary-fitted integration of implicit limb/occultation curves, conditioning/efficiency of CPUgeometry bridge and independently refined continuous thermal/irradiation/radiance fields before1e-4 fit qualification.

timing_conditions.curves: Matched reference/GPU complete constructor+freshfield+CPUgeometry/masks+device integration+alltransfers+raw/normalized/component host output. Same unit,affinity0-15/Nice10,threads1,FP64. CPU source/reference first; sources/shapes may warm caches. Single measurements, no throughput distributions.
timing_conditions.likelihood: Reference sub-timer includes original predict_light_curves serialization/time layer; selected sub-timer starts with a prepared physical binary, then curve/mapping/density. Do not present their ratio as complete callback speedup. All serialization, constructors, coarse numerical preflight, priors, extra references and comparisons included in full studywall.
timing_conditions.startup: Mainwall starts after imports; separate commandwalls include Python/import startup. Unitdevice probe and checkpoint/restore overhead reported separately. CPU development while production runs excluded from matched performance evidence.
timing_conditions.memory: Node cap counts quadrature nodes, not peak memory. Up to7probes per candidate leaf and CPUroot/geometry arrays, JIT/runtime/allocator and deviceoutputs add storage. No whole-model peak-memory claim. Surface integration uploads padded selectednodes band-by-band.
timing_conditions.inference: CPUgeometry dominates these hybrid curves; accuracy stops prevent turning any measured cost into qualified fitting/MCMC/ESS gain.
